subject: Expansion & renewal: allocate new API key namespaces for Brightline teams
messages:
From: Sam Wu <sam.wu@brightline.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Expansion request + renewal conversation

Hi Rachel —

Quick note while we’re finalizing renewal: several product teams at Brightline want to onboard additional projects this quarter (Clinical Triage, Member Messaging, and Care Ops). We need: 

- Separate API keys / namespaces for each team (approx 3–5 keys initially)
- Guidance on per-key rate limits and recommended batch sizes (we care about latency for triage flows)
- A cost estimate for adding ~3 teams + projected monthly tokens if we run 1M tokens/month across them (existing contract attached)

We’re open to rolling the expansion into the renewal amendment if that’s simpler. Can we schedule 30 minutes this week to review capacity and any term changes (commit increases / discount tiers)? Contracts@brightline will want an early draft.

Thanks —
Sam
Sam Wu
Head of Integrations, Brightline Health
sam.wu@brightline.com
+1 415-555-5162

Attachments: Brightline-current-usage-202704.pdf (summary)
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Sam Wu <sam.wu@brightline.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion request + renewal conversation

Hi Sam —

Thanks for the heads up and the usage snapshot. Happy to fold the expansion into the renewal amendment; that’s usually the cleanest path. High level next steps I propose: 

1) Internal scoping call at Redwood (runtime capacity & rate limits) — I’ll loop in Monica (CS lead) and Ben (AE) so we can confirm per-key rate SLOs and cost delta.
2) Draft amendment for Brightline covering: new key namespaces, per-key limits, 60-day staged activation, pricing for incremental commit level.
3) Legal/contract touchpoint with contracts@brightline for redlines.

I can do 30 mins Wed 14:00–14:30 PT or Thu 11:00–11:30 PT. Which works for you?

Rachel
Rachel Kim
Senior Account Manager | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com

Attachments: Proposed-activation-stagger.xlsx (skeleton plan)
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: FW: Expansion request + renewal conversation

Team —

FYI: Brightline (Sam) is asking to add 3 teams / projects and wants to bundle this into the renewal. Key asks below; please reply with your availability and any blockers.

Summary from Sam: separate API keys per project (3–5), latency-sensitive triage flow, cost estimate for +3 teams (~1M tokens/month across them).

Specific items I need from you: 
- Monica: recommended per-key rate limits, whether we should carve dedicated capacity or use shared (their latency constraints may push dedicated pool). Also share any known onboarding time for 3 new namespaces.
- Ben: pricing posture — what discount tiers make sense if they move to a +commit level for the next 12 months? We should propose 10–15% list for starter, with structure by commit band.
- Laura: can you draft a short amendment template (one page) we can send to contracts@brightline? Keep it minimal: new keys, activation windows, pricing, billing cadence, and SLA notes.

Proposed rollout (tentative):
- Week 0: contract amendment signed / keys provisioned (3 namespaces)
- Week 1–4: phased activation per team (one project live every 8–10 days)
- Week 5–8: monitoring & auto-tuning (batching and KV cache) with playbook from CS

I’ll run the Wed 14 PT slot with Sam if that works for everyone; otherwise Thu 11 PT.

-Rachel
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FW: Expansion request + renewal conversation

Thanks Rachel. Quick notes from infra/CS perspective: 

- For triage flows we recommend isolating that project on a small Dedicated pool (NVIDIA A10x2), or at minimum a guaranteed min-QPS reservation on shared. The other two projects (Member Messaging, Care Ops) are OK on shared with conservative rate caps initially.
- Per-key starter limits: 20 RPS sustained, 200 concurrent tokens for member messaging; triage should start at 60 RPS with burst to 120 for peak windows. We can provide a traffic-shaping policy to prevent noisy neighbors.
- Onboarding timeline: once keys are provisioned we can get the first team live in ~5 business days; full phased activation for 3 teams in 3–4 weeks with CS playbook.
- Monitoring: we’ll push a dashboard and an alert for latency > 250ms p50 for triage.

I’ll prepare the playbook snippet and attachment (Brightline-expansion-MAP-20270517.xlsx) before the Wed call.

-Monica
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FW: Expansion request + renewal conversation

Hey team —

Good notes. I ran pricing scenarios with finance. Proposal we call out in the amendment: 

- Baseline: add 3 namespaces, on current MSRP; no changes to base commit.
- Option A (recommended): +30% commit uplift for 12 months in exchange for 12% discount on incremental usage and waived setup fee for Dedicated pool for triage project (one-time).
- Option B: No commit change, per-namespace overage pricing at 1.4x list with a 90-day review.

If Sam signs Option A we can lock a dedicated slot for the triage project and include staged activation language. Laura — please include both options in the amendment so Brightline can choose quickly. I’ll go to the Wed call with an outline and a sample amendment PDF.

-Ben
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

--- Forwarded to external ---
From: Sam Wu <sam.wu@brightline.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Contracts <contracts@brightline.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 08:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion request + renewal conversation

Rachel / team —

Appreciate the speedy responses and the options. Brightline legal wants the amendment draft; they prefer Option A if you can commit to the dedicated slot guarantees you mentioned. Can you: 

1) Send a one-page amendment + docuSign link for Option A
2) Provision three namespaces with placeholder keys (we’ll integrate and smoke-test once the amendment is in flight)
3) Share the CS playbook and monitoring dashboard link so our SREs can review the alert thresholds

We’re aiming to sign the renewal + expansion by next week. Contracts are standing by.

Sam

Attachments: Proposed-amendment-Brightline.pdf (draft)
